# Gramlot Python Server 0.2.12 — Nested gallery integration

Stage the numbered gallery hierarchy with nested URLs and companions. Folder
indexes, Markdown pages, lazy directory navigation and shared gallery Logic use
the coordinated core and examples contracts under each adapter mount prefix.
Uvicorn, FastAPI, Django, Flask and Kajenn retain the common host protocol.

This release includes only gallery integration; database selectors and Genropy
integration experiments are excluded. Upgrade core and examples with the adapter.
